metadata.source: Forestry Grant Scheme (FGS) and Agri-Environment Climate Scheme (AECS) published rates, ruralpayments.org
metadata.verify_policy: Every grant rate carries a source URL and a verify note. Published FGS and AECS rates must be re-checked against ruralpayments.org before release. Cost rates are working estimates, not published figures.

sitka_spruce.label: Sitka Spruce
sitka_spruce.note: Lower value softwood; commonest PAWS species in Fife

larch.label: Larch
larch.note: Good timber value; significant Phytophthora disease risk flags may apply

mixed_broadleaf.label: Mixed broadleaf (firewood grade)
mixed_broadleaf.note: Standing broadleaf or non-native removals sold as firewood. Estimate — verify against local roadside firewood prices.

fgs_grants.note: Forestry Grant Scheme (FGS) Scotland. The first four entries are the legacy PAWS model rates and are kept unchanged so existing PAWS results do not move.

deer_fencing_grant_per_m.label: Deer fencing grant
deer_fencing_grant_per_m.source: FGS Woodland Creation Table 5, 'Deer fence – high cost' £9.90/m — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-creation/
deer_fencing_grant_per_m.verify: Matches the published high-cost deer fence rate. Standard deer fence is £7.60/m (Woodland Creation) or £9.50/m (Woodland Improvement Grant).

tree_protection_per_tree.label: Tree protection (stakes)
tree_protection_per_tree.source: Legacy PAWS model value. Nearest published item: FGS 'Tree Shelter: 1.2 to 1.8 Metres' £2.00 each — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-creation/
tree_protection_per_tree.verify: Legacy £2.20 is above the published £2.00 shelter rate. Kept for PAWS regression; Simon to confirm.

restocking_grant_per_ha.label: Restocking grant
restocking_grant_per_ha.source: Legacy PAWS model value. Published FGS 'Woodland Improvement Grant – Restructuring Regeneration' is £300/ha (UKFS) or £550/ha (Diversity and Resilience) — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/restructuring-regeneration/
restocking_grant_per_ha.verify: Legacy £2,400/ha is far above the published restocking rates. Kept unchanged so PAWS results match; Simon to confirm which FGS item this was meant to represent.

rhododendron_clearance_per_ha.label: Rhododendron clearance
rhododendron_clearance_per_ha.source: Legacy PAWS model value. Published FGS WIG Habitats and Species 'Rhododendron Eradication' ranges £2,200–£7,300/ha of infested land — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/habitats-and-species/
rhododendron_clearance_per_ha.verify: Legacy £1,500/ha is below every published rhododendron eradication rate. Kept for PAWS regression; requires a 10-year Rhododendron Control Plan.

fgs_grants.note_regen: Legacy PAWS assumption: natural regen attracts ~70% of the active planting grant rate

wc_native_broadleaves_initial_per_ha.label: Woodland Creation – Native Broadleaves (initial planting)
wc_native_broadleaves_initial_per_ha.source: FGS Woodland Creation Table 1, standard areas — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-creation/ (PDF published 6 Oct 2025)
wc_native_broadleaves_initial_per_ha.verify: Standard-area rate. Target areas pay £2,070/ha. Rates fall above 300 ha. Minimum 1,600 stems/ha at year 5.

wc_native_broadleaves_annual_per_ha_yr.label: Woodland Creation – annual maintenance (5 yrs)
wc_native_broadleaves_annual_per_ha_yr.source: FGS Woodland Creation Table 1, standard areas — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-creation/
wc_native_broadleaves_annual_per_ha_yr.verify: Paid for five years (or as two Establishment Operations capital items). Target areas pay £306/ha/yr.

wc_deer_fence_per_m.label: Deer fencing grant
wc_deer_fence_per_m.verify: Standard deer fence. High-cost deer fence is £9.90/m where justified.

wc_vole_guard_each.label: Vole guards
wc_vole_guard_each.verify: Assumes the site is deer fenced so shelters are not needed (FGS presumes fencing is the preferred protection).

wig_deer_fence_per_m.label: Deer fencing grant
wig_deer_fence_per_m.source: FGS WIG Habitats and Species 'Deer Fence' — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/habitats-and-species/
wig_deer_fence_per_m.verify: Woodland Improvement Grant rate for existing woodland.

wig_stock_fence_per_m.label: Stock fencing grant
wig_stock_fence_per_m.source: FGS WIG Habitats and Species 'Stock Fence' — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/habitats-and-species/

wig_small_scale_planting_per_tree.label: Small-scale tree and shrub planting
wig_small_scale_planting_per_tree.source: FGS WIG Habitats and Species 'Small-scale Tree and Shrub Planting' — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/habitats-and-species/
wig_small_scale_planting_per_tree.verify: Used for enrichment planting in existing native woodland. Rate includes shelter; confirm eligibility with the local conservancy.

wig_new_natural_regen_per_ha.label: New natural regeneration establishment
wig_new_natural_regen_per_ha.source: FGS WIG Habitats and Species 'New Natural Regeneration Establishment' — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/habitats-and-species/
wig_new_natural_regen_per_ha.verify: Applied to the natural-regen share of the site. Confirm whether regen for new woodland is funded here or under Woodland Creation.

wig_rhodo_mechanised_medium_per_ha.label: Rhododendron eradication (mechanised, medium)
wig_rhodo_mechanised_medium_per_ha.source: FGS WIG Habitats and Species 'Rhododendron Eradication – Mechanised – Medium' — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/habitats-and-species/
wig_rhodo_mechanised_medium_per_ha.verify: Per hectare of infested land. Published range is £2,200 (mechanised light) to £7,300 (manual difficult). Needs a 10-year Rhododendron Control Plan.

wig_scrub_intermediate_per_ha.label: Scrub / invasive clearance (intermediate)
wig_scrub_intermediate_per_ha.source: FGS WIG Habitats and Species 'Scrub / Woody Vegetation Eradication – Intermediate' — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/habitats-and-species/
wig_scrub_intermediate_per_ha.verify: Light is £1,100/ha and heavy £2,200/ha of infested land.

wig_single_standard_tree_each.label: Replacement or new single standard tree
wig_single_standard_tree_each.source: FGS WIG 'Replacement or New Single Standard Tree' — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/forestry-grant-scheme-capital-items/replacement-or-new-single-standard-tree/
wig_single_standard_tree_each.verify: Only for landscape purposes under WIG Habitats and Species or WIAT. Includes protection and aftercare. AECS 'Replacement or Planting of Individual Trees within Ancient Wood Pasture' may be the better fit.

wig_woodland_grazing_plan.label: Woodland Grazing Management Plan
wig_woodland_grazing_plan.source: FGS Woodland Improvement Grant planning options — https://www.ruralpayments.org/topics/all-schemes/forestry-grant-scheme/woodland-improvement-grant/

smf_native_woodland_per_ha_yr.label: Sustainable Management – Native Woodland (5 yrs)
smf_native_woodland_per_ha_yr.verify: Annual, up to five years. Requires a Forest Plan or Management Plan and annual herbivore impact monitoring.

smf_woodland_grazing_per_ha_yr.label: Sustainable Management – Woodland Grazing (5 yrs)
smf_woodland_grazing_per_ha_yr.verify: Annual, up to five years. Needs an approved Woodland Grazing Management Plan.

agroforestry_low_initial_per_ha.label: Agroforestry establishment (150–200 trees/ha)
agroforestry_low_initial_per_ha.verify: Rate covers trees, protection, planting and beating up. Minimum 150 stems/ha at year 5. Area 0.5–15 ha per farm business.

agroforestry_low_annual_per_ha_yr.label: Agroforestry maintenance (5 yrs)
agroforestry_low_annual_per_ha_yr.verify: Paid for five years at the 150–200 trees/ha density.

agroforestry_high_initial_per_ha.label: Agroforestry establishment (300–400 trees/ha)
agroforestry_high_initial_per_ha.verify: Minimum 300 stems/ha at year 5. Densities between 201 and 299 trees/ha are modelled at the lower rate.

agroforestry_high_annual_per_ha_yr.label: Agroforestry maintenance (5 yrs)
agroforestry_high_annual_per_ha_yr.verify: Paid for five years at the 300–400 trees/ha density.

aecs_grants.note: Agri-Environment Climate Scheme (AECS) hedgerow option and capital items. AECS contracts run five years; capital items are paid once on completion.

hedge_planting_per_m.label: Planting or replanting of hedges
hedge_planting_per_m.verify: Gapping up is only eligible for gaps over 5 m. Double row, minimum 6 plants/m, at least three native species. Must be combined with stock fence or guards. Shared boundaries claim half.

hedge_laying_per_m.label: Laying of hedges
hedge_laying_per_m.verify: Claimable once per length during the contract. Lay between 1 September and 31 March.

hedge_coppicing_per_m.label: Coppicing of hedges
hedge_coppicing_per_m.verify: Coppice between 1 December and end of February. Claimable once per length.

stock_fence_per_m.label: Stock fencing grant
stock_fence_per_m.verify: £2.75/m on a shared boundary. Not funded if an existing fence would last the 5-year contract. New fences at least 1 m from hedge centre line.

vole_guards_per_m.label: Vole guards (hedge planting)
vole_guards_per_m.verify: Per metre of planted hedge. Guard at least 20 cm tall.

rabbit_hare_guards_per_m.label: Rabbit or hare guards (hedge planting)
rabbit_hare_guards_per_m.verify: Per metre of planted hedge. Not combinable with rabbit-proof fencing.

hedge_management_per_m_yr.label: Management or restoration of hedgerows (5 yrs)
hedge_management_per_m_yr.verify: Annual per linear metre of managed hedge. Needs a hedgerow management plan; available throughout Scotland.

hedge_creation_per_m_yr.label: Creation of hedgerows (5 yrs)
hedge_creation_per_m_yr.verify: Only available inside the Creation of Hedgerows target area (check with the AECS targeting tool). New hedge must link existing farmland habitats.

costs.note_fencing: Real-world contractor rate; FGS grant covers ~82% of this
costs.note_tree: Bare-root native broadleaf whips, including stakes and guards
costs.note_diy_fencing: Materials only — assumes landowner provides labour
costs.note_diy_planting: Materials only — bare-root whips, no contractor planting labour
costs.note_rhodo: Estimate for mechanised clearance of medium infestation; DIY assumes landowner labour with hired flail/herbicide. Verify with local contractors.

esg.note: Private BNG / ESG sponsorship from distilleries, corporates. WCC carbon credits NOT applicable to PAWS restocking.

long_term_values.note: 15-year projected annual values per hectare of restored broadleaf woodland
long_term_values.note_bng: Annualised BNG credit value assuming 30-year credit agreement

paws.label: PAWS restoration
paws.description: Conifer plantation on an ancient woodland site — clearfell, restock with native broadleaves.

costs.note_rhodo: Legacy PAWS model never charged a clearance cost. Held at 0 so existing PAWS results are unchanged — Simon to decide whether to add one.

native_woodland.label: Native woodland
native_woodland.description: Degraded native or secondary woodland — enrichment planting, natural regeneration and invasive control.

native_broadleaf_mix.label: Native broadleaf mix (oak, birch, rowan, hazel)

costs.note_tree: Enrichment planting on the non-regen share: whip, 1.2 m shelter and stake. Estimate.

long_term_values.note: Per ha/yr once canopy recovers. Estimate — verify.

new_woodland.label: New native woodland
new_woodland.description: New native woodland on open ground, by planting or natural regeneration (FGS Woodland Creation).

native_broadleaf_mix.label: Native broadleaf mix (oak, birch, rowan, hazel)

costs.note_tree: Fenced site: bare-root whip, vole guard, ground prep and planting labour. Estimate.

long_term_values.note: Per ha/yr as the young wood establishes. Estimate — verify.

wood_pasture.label: Wood pasture
wood_pasture.description: Open grazed woodland with scattered standard trees, managed under a woodland grazing plan.

costs.note_tree: Standard tree with post-and-rail or heavy-duty cattle guard. Estimate.
costs.note_fencing: Stock fence, contractor vs materials only. Estimate.

agroforestry.label: Agroforestry
agroforestry.description: Silvopasture or silvoarable — trees at low density on grazing or arable land (FGS Agroforestry).

costs.note_tree: Feathered tree, mesh guard and stake, planted. Estimate.
costs.note_fencing: Agroforestry grant includes tree protection; any extra stock fencing is a cost only.

hedgerow.label: Hedgerow
hedgerow.description: Gapping-up, laying, coppicing or new planting of farm hedges (AECS).

diverse_mix.label: Diverse native mix (hawthorn, blackthorn, hazel, holly, dog rose)

costs.note: Contractor rates include labour; DIY is materials and tool hire only. All estimates — verify with local hedge contractors.

long_term_values.note: Per km/yr of restored hedge. Estimate — verify.
